philippines.title: UAAP: Redemption fueled NU win over La Salle, says Jumamoy
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines—Reinhard Jumamoy had plenty of motivation on Sunday when National University took on defending champion La Salle in the second round of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Aside from wanting to avenge the Bulldogs’ first-round loss, Jumamoy recalled how the Green Archers broke their hearts last year in the Final Four. “I told my teammates that this is our redemption. La Salle eliminated us last year,” he said after NU’s 84-80 win. “That became such a motivation for me. philippines.title: Hontiveros: Too early to say there’s already a number for VP conviction
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — It’s still premature to say that there is already a number enough to convict or acquit Vice President Sara Duterte as her impeachment trial remains ongoing, according to Sen. Risa Hontiveros. “I think premature for me or for anyone to say that there is already a number for conviction or number for acquittal because we have only heard one side,” she said in an interview on radio dzBB on Sunday.
